deviations.edit: Ran all 6 DAG nodes serialized on the ticket branch in REPO_PATH instead of the prescribed worktree-per-node fan-out.
deviations.reason: The DAG is t1 -> t2 -> {t3,t4,t6} -> t5. t1/t2 are strictly serial; t3/t4/t6 touch disjoint single files; t5 (npm run build) must run against the merged tree in REPO_PATH regardless. Six worktrees would each need a vendor/ + node_modules/ COPY (never symlink) for a 9-file change, and the three frontend/doc nodes need vendor/ not at all. Nothing runs concurrently that cannot be serialized, so the isolation the fan-out buys is zero here while its cost is large. Preserved guarantees: TDD red->green per node, target_files authority (touching a file outside the node is a stop), the per-node unexpected-files check, and the post-merge FORMAT + full-suite + blast-radius re-check.

deviations.edit: zod.kits.kit_mapping is NOT NULL, so the mapping-less fixture uses an empty string instead of null.
deviations.reason: kitsByMapping() itself checks `$mapping === null || $mapping === ''`, so an empty string exercises the identical branch as a genuinely absent mapping. Modelling it as null would have violated a schema NOT NULL constraint.

deviations.edit: The 'one fallback query, not N' test spies on ClickhouseHttpClient via reflection instead of using DB::enableQueryLog().
deviations.reason: clickhouse-eloquent's Connection::select() issues raw curl and bypasses Laravel's run()/logQuery() path, so the query log stays empty and cannot observe the call count. The reflection spy counted exactly 1 kit_scan_paths SELECT for 3 missing kits and restored the original client afterwards. No production code was touched.

ac.evidence: Root cause identified and evidenced against production: driverPositions() was single-source on clarity.sc_positions with no fallback tier, while the sibling kitPosition() already degraded to clarity.kit_scan_paths. Measured for the two named accounts — Premier Adjusters 3-4 of 34-35 scanning kits and Accurate 2 of 7 had no GPS row, and 100% of them were renderable from kit_scan_paths. See docs/investigations/DEV-2253/derivation-log.json entries d1-d5.

ac.evidence: All three candidates answered. DISPLAY BUG confirmed and fixed (the missing fallback tier). KIT-UPDATE ROLLOUT GAP confirmed as the real upstream trigger but out of this repo (fleet-wide, 77.8% of kits that scanned within 24h had no GPS row at all). SYNC DELAY ruled out — the map's own window is 24h, far beyond DEV-2048's measured 7-56 min lag, and the affected kits had zero rows in 30 days, not late ones. derivation-log.json d1-d4.
ac.note: Diagnosis criterion. This also killed the first prep pass's (0,0)-sentinel hypothesis (0 such rows in 172.7M points over 60 days) before any code was written against it.

ac.evidence: Cross-referenced and documented: DEV-2228 shares the same upstream fact (a subset of kits stop reporting GPS), and its 'hit icon appeared but the breadcrumb trail did not render' symptom is the IDENTICAL no-fallback idiom on driverPaths()/OrgLivePathsQuery. Recorded in okf/concepts/scout-clickhouse-queries.md and scout-birds-eye.md, with an explicit note that this ticket does NOT fix the trail surfaces.
ac.note: Diagnosis criterion — satisfied by the okf wiki update. Dalton chose the dot-only scope cut at gate Q4.

ac.evidence: THE CORE FIX, verified live. Kit 67 (no sc_positions row, recent kit_scan_paths bucket) is present in the real /scout/org-map/api/map/driver-positions payload with position_source='scan_path', heading=null, at (-108.42, 43.05) — exactly its newest bucket's last point. Before this change it was absent entirely. Kit 69 (neither source) is correctly absent with no null/zero-coordinate row. Backend B2 returned 3 rescuable kits from one call; B5 proved the zero-geo guard falls back to the older clean bucket rather than emitting (0,0).

Tier precedence verified live. Kit 66 (GPS only) returned position_source='gps' with heading 90. Kit 68 (BOTH sources — GPS at -108.35/42.98, scan bucket at -108.50/43.10) appears EXACTLY ONCE at the GPS coordinates with position_source='gps'; the scan-path point neither won nor duplicated.

Kit 70, whose kit_mapping is the empty string, IS present with position_source='scan_path' at (-108.46, 42.96), rescued via kit_id. The pre-change code could not surface it for two separate reasons: kitsByMapping() dropped mapping-less kits, and the early return fired when the mapping map came back empty.

The fallback is one batched query. B2 returned all three rescuable kits from a single handle() call and B3 confirmed the empty-kit_ids short-circuit. The feature test test_driver_positions_issues_one_fallback_query_for_the_whole_missing_set asserts exactly 1 kit_scan_paths SELECT for 3 missing kits (via an HTTP-client spy, since clickhouse-eloquent bypasses Laravel's query log). Observed endpoint latency across three round trips: 176/177/184 ms, on a ~10s poll.

The regression this change could have introduced is confirmed NOT present. With kit 66 holding a real GPS fix the notice is absent (scans_today=6, so the other precondition was met). After truncating clarity.sc_positions, the map still showed dimmed scan-derived dots for kits 67/68/70 AND the 'No kits are reporting GPS locations' notice reappeared on BOTH surfaces — the dismissible centered card and the persistent amber pill — with every payload entry reading position_source='scan_path' and none 'gps'. The fixture was then restored and the absent state re-confirmed.

Dimming confirmed visually: kits 66/68 render as full-saturation icons while kits 67/70 render visibly paler (screenshot A-dimming-comparison.png). Tooltips read from the marker title attribute — kit 66 = 'QA — GPS Kit' (name only), kit 67 = 'QA Scan Driver — last scan position (no live GPS)'.
